name: Dramatic Deep Dive
description: Full-Kanto Deep Dive preview with two-layer hydrology: real surface water remains the DIVE/SURFACE entry mask while bridges, docks and pontoons preserve continuous swimmable water and seabed underneath. Includes seamless underwater route connections, cave/harbor portals, biome-aware geology and lighting, living Pokedex-scaled Pokemon, salvage, Wilds/Sky compatibility and HM08 DIVE. Surface DIVE masking remains disabled because all real water is diveable.
